g.text: Transfer - Idempotency + Transactional Outbox + States + Reconciliation
Validate token, scopes and SOURCE-account AUTHORIZATION
Client retries with a valid step-up ACR
INSERT order (PENDING) + INSERT UNIQUE(idempotency_key) + INSERT outbox(bp.transfer.requested.v1)
Circuit breaker + retry(backoff) ONLY for transient/idempotent errors
